title: Pending Until Proven
description: A freshly-requested report hasn't actually been built yet — the job's own record should say so honestly the instant it's created, before the queue has done any work.
successCondition: POST /api/reporting/jobs with a valid from/to/groupBy/timeZone body. The 202 response's job.status is not "ready". Immediately (without waiting) querying the report_jobs table via `npm run db:psql` for that job's id confirms status = 'pending' and result_csv IS NULL — the row exists but genuinely has no generated content yet.
hints: ReportJobStatus defaults to "pending" at the Prisma schema level (prisma/schema.prisma) — the queued job that builds the CSV hasn't run yet at the moment this INSERT happens.
Query immediately after the POST response, before any queue delay could elapse, to catch the true initial state.
